name: Hardcore Teacher ~Zettai Fukujuu e no Logic~
original_name: ハードコア・ティーチャー ～絶対服従へのロジック～
source:
Yuri Sanjuu. Her mind is hazy, but slowly she finds herself coming back to her senses.
She squirms, realizing that she’s half-naked, her limbs bound to a chair, and her legs spread far apart.
When she finally notices me, her eyes widen in shock.

“P-Principal? What on earth is going on here?”

As the principal of a prestigious all-girls school, I often oversee the girls engaging in their club activities. I’m not watching the girls in their swimsuits and gym uniforms for fun, of course. It’s part of my job.
However, one of the teachers, Yuri Sanjuu, has been telling people that I’ve been ogling at the girls with a lecherous gaze.
So I invite her to my office, under the pretense of explaining our school policy, and offer her ‘a cup of coffee’...
The lady, no doubt exhausted from a long day of work, soon falls asleep.
So I take her somewhere where she can ‘relax.’
“I’m going to sue you! I’ll sue you!”
“Are you sure you can do that, Ms. Yuri?”
I’ve borrowed a video camera from a nearby love hotel. Propped up on a tripod, its lens is pointed directly at the half naked teacher tied to the chair.
“If you sue me, perhaps you could use this video as proof.”
I doubt she’s gonna want to sue me anymore.
Now certain of that, I slowly walk towards her.
And the half-naked woman thrashes against her restraints even harder than before...
